Upper Text: [When Digivolving][When Attacking] You may trash up to 2 blue cards in your hand. For each card trashed by this effect, choose 1 card under an opponent’s Digimon or Tamer and trash it. Then, you may return 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of their deck.

[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When one of your blue Digimon would be deleted, by returning 3 cards with [Jellymon] in their texts from your trash to the bottom of your deck in any order, prevent that Digimon from being deleted.
